name: Chicken grilled in a clay pot
summary: Chicken grilled in a clay pot over embers, with crisp golden skin and meat that stays soft. It comes with crispy rice, scallion fat, and lemongrass salt.
origin: Củ Chi. Báo Quốc tế, on 11 Aug 2024, names gà nướng lu than hồng among local chicken plates.
howToEat: Grill the chicken in a clay pot over embers. Eat it with crispy rice, scallion fat, and lemongrass salt.
seoTitle: Clay-pot grilled chicken in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Chicken grilled in a clay pot, crisp skin and soft meat, with crispy rice and lemongrass salt.
taste: The skin is golden and crisp, and the meat stays soft.
